title: an order() that throws in the middle of a sort stops it with that error
purpose: Verify the public library contract with exact, independently derived values.

provenance.expected_basis: A failure of Comparing.order() propagates out of ordering() as its typed error; the sort neither crashes nor returns a partly ordered array, and a later sort still works. 1 and 999972 are the least and greatest of (i * 7919 + 13) % 1000003 for i < 100000.
